dialogue.text: Wait--!
What, wait now? Is this the best time to be stopping?
I need to scout the area, alone. You samurai wait here until I return.
Uh... wait here and do what exactly?
I don't know... be discreet for a change?
I'll be right back!
Discreet?! We're samurai for goodness sake -- not shrubbery!
Guys, let's use that ladder General Daisuke gave us. Chikako can catch us up when she's finished sneaking around.
This looks like a good place to assemble the ladder.
I'll set it up while you guys keep watch. We don't want the Murasaki Tsuki to know we're --
Intruders are trying to scale the wall!
Stop them!
Too late, Satoshi! They're on to us!
Bah! I was through sneaking around anyway.
Guys, cover me while I get this ladder ready!

step.title: Use the ladder to scale the Inner Wall

dialogue.text: The ladder is up. Let's go!

step.title: Use the ladder to scale the Inner Wall

dialogue.text: You idiots!
What part of "act discreet" didn't you samurai understand?
Chikako?!
Hey, how'd you get in here?
Tsk! Through stealth, patience and subtlety... you?
Uh, we used a ladder...
Yes, and woke the entire castle up because of it!
Didn't I tell you to stay put until I came back?

choice.text: She can't boss us around like that!

dialogue.text: Let's discuss the rights and wrongs of our actions after we've completed our mission, okay?
Tsk! Fine, I suppose we've wasted enough time already.
Thanks to you, we have an entire castle of armed samurai looking for us.
We shouldn't linger here. This way!
Hey! Who put you in charge anyway, Chikako? This is our mission -- not yours!
Huh! I knew it would be a waste of time trying to teach you samurai anything. You're all the same; thick-armed and thick-headed.
Let's just hurry up and complete the mission.
Don't be angry with the other guys, hummingbird! It was all my fault, you see; I was worried about your safety, and I just can't bear to be parted from you.
Sigh! Worry about your own safety. I can look after myself perfectly fine.

Friend, you go with Chikako and get the gates opened.
We'll handle things down here!

dialogue.text: Warriors of the Murasaki Tsuki! Slay the invaders!
Be careful here, samurai. This man is General Yohei, a fearsome warrior of the Murasaki Tsuki.

choice.text: Man... he looks a lot bigger up close.

dialogue.text: I recognize this guy, and he doesn't look so tough to me.
Well, if it isn't the cowardly mongrel who sought my lord's life ...
Where is the rest of you mangy pack, little mongrel? Surely even the Shira Tancho have more honor than to send an upstart brat to fight their battles for them?

choice.text: We're not here for this guy.
All Murasaki Tsuki deserve to die!

dialogue.text: Step aside, General Yohei. We're here for Gojo Takamori, not you.
Grrr...! The only thing you will find here is your death, you impudent wretch! My master has taken what he came here for and traveled with our allies to complete the final stage of our plan.
"Taken what he came here for"? What could the Cha Tonbo possibly possess that would cause the Murasaki Tsuki to invade their land in such numbers?

A trinket of the Cha Tonbo's... a relic. My master ordered me to kill every last one of the Cha Tonbo in this castle in order to retrieve it. And now that we have, victory for the Murasaki Tsuki is close at hand...

choice.text: If he tells us where Takamori has gone, I'll let him live.
I'll beat him until he tells me everything he knows!

dialogue.text: Then tell me where we can find your master, Yohei. I'm giving you one final chance to confess everything you know!
Grr…! You upstart brat! I will impale your lifeless corpse, cut out yours eyes, and set the crows to feast on your innards.
After that, I will take your heads and present them to my lord.
For I am General Yohei, known to my master’s enemies as the bloodied maw of the Gray Wolf! Stone and Bone alike fall beneath my mighty blade!
Then it looks like we're going to have to beat you until you talk, Yohei.
Your clan owes us, Yohei. We're taking you down.
And then we're going to drag your master out of this castle and make him pay for his crimes.
This guy's got to be twelve feet tall...
Hmm... more like seven.

I'm sure you samurai can handle the rest.

choice.text: I'm grateful to her for the help.
I can't bare to be parted from her!

dialogue.text: But, uh... good luck and stay safe. I'd hate to have to rescue you again.
Now get back to general Daisuke's camp and tell him everything you have learned.
Gojo Takamori must be stopped!
And don't come back this time!
Ha! Is your pride dented, samurai?
Good!
Please don't get hurt, beloved. I...I don't know what I'd do without you!
Sigh! Just focus on completing your mission. I'll be fine.
And stop calling me beloved!
Youngsters!
Heh! I'm glad to see you're still safe.
Excellent work opening the gate, samurai.
My warriors are assaulting the castle as we speak. If all goes to plan, it will be back in Cha Tonbo hands very soon.
We will have Takamori hung from the highest wall of our castle before the day is out.
You'll have to wait a little longer for Takamori's head, Daisuke-sama. That snake isn't here.
It was never Gojo Takamori's intention to occupy the Cha Tonbo's lands. He invaded in order to secure one of your clan's relics.
The only relic of any significance within the castle is a small stone dragon statue our kinsmen unearthed many centuries ago.
It was kept in a small shrine in the center of the castle, and some within our clan considered it important enough to offer prayers to.
A dragon statue? Say, you guys don't reckon it's --
The talisman we were searching for? I'd bet my life on it, Fumio,
That mad devil Takamori's meddling will spell doom for this country if he isn't stopped -- you mark my words.
But all is not yet lost. We have the Sealing Gourd, and with it we can prevent Takamori completing the ceremony.
Yeah, but we don't even know where to find him.
Hmm. Daisuke-sama, what can you tell us about the Kanji ruins in your land?
The ruins? Alas very little. We Cha Tonbo prefer to leave them undisturbed.
Sigh! If only everyone were as wise as you, Daisuke-sama. But now I must ask you a favor -- one that will decide the fate of this land.
Then speak, Kojuro-san. I will ensure you receive it.
The fastest scouts you have available, that'll do for a start. Send them far and wide across the land, and ask them to locate Takamori's army.
Consider it done. I will dispatch riders immediately.
You should head to Munei Town to rest up and resupply. A messenger will be sent to you when Takamori's army has been located.
Once the last of the Murasaki Tsuki are subdued, I will seek you out and join you as well. We can then put an end to Gojo Takamori once and for all.

choice.text: Isn't there something else he can give us?

Once the castle is secure and the last of the Murasaki Tsuki driven out, I will take what is left of my army and meet you.
That is the best I can do.
I thank you for your assistance, Daisuke-sama. We'll leave at once.
Regardless of what the future may hold for us all, you will always be remembered as heroes of the Cha Tonbo, warriors.
Good luck, and may fortune walk with you.
I made a recall stone for getting us quickly into the castle.

We have done as General Daisuke ordered and located the Murasaki Tsuki.
They're traveling due north, following the road through Yoshiharah.
The army is moderate in size, perhaps no more than a few hundred warriors, mainly undead.
A few hundred? That's a heck of a lot of bodies to fight through.
I mean, I may be a wreckless, feckless, devil-may-care gambler... but even I don't like those odds.
Me neither, but what other choice do we have?

choice.text: We should wait for Daisuke to send more troops.
We don't have the time to stand around.

dialogue.text: General Daisuke should be on his way to meet us. We should stay put and wait for him to arrive.
And risk letting that mad devil complete the ceremony? No, we need to get moving at once.
Think about the consequences if we fail now: the entire Empire overrun by the Murasaki Tsuki's undead armies... Takamori with the shogunate in his palm.
His triumph with spell doom for this land.
Hey, you don't need to convince me any, Kojuro-san. I'm as eager to stop Takamori as you are, but we won't be able to do it alone.
Maybe we can, uh... get ahead of Takamori's army or something, maybe lay another ambush?
Sigh! Fumio, buddy... didn't we go over this before? Ambushes are bad -- they don't work. We tried it before, remember?
Heh! Yes, but you didn't have me with you last time, nor did you have the Sealing Gourd!
All we need to put paid to Takamori's plans is this gourd, Masahiro's body, and two minutes of uninterrupted time for me to perform the ritual.
I'm sure you youngsters could manage to give me that, yes?
Two minutes... that's all you need?
Heh! Yes, that's all I need! I've been studying all the old Kanji scrolls I have in my collection, and I have the ritual memorized perfectly.
Now young man, which path is the quickest route through the forest?
Keep heading north and you will reach your destination.
Takamori's forces will no doubt be moving slowly. An army of undead is difficult to coordinate.
Just get me close enough so that I can exorcise the Void Key. Once the Void Key is safe inside the Sealing Gourd, Takamori's plan will be in ruins.
Heh! Now that's a sight I hope I live long enough to see.
I say to hell with the odds. We need to stop Takamori from completing the ceremony, even if that means fighting through an entire army.
You're right there, youngster. Takamori must be stopped before he opens the Kanji shrine.
We're certainly on the right track. Do you see the foot prints in the earth?
Hmm, a large force of warriors passed through here not long ago.
Say, why are all these mounds of earth here for?
Uh-oh!
Great... an ambush!
It looks like Takamori was expecting us.
Man, I thought we were the ones who were supposed to be doing the ambushing!
We need to fight our way past them!
Is that all of them?
Not quite... Look!
There's more over here!
It looks like we're surrounded.
Damn! You know, this is turning out to be a seriously bad day...
It looks like we've bought ourselves a little breathing space.
Yes, enough time to pick up the trail and get out of here.
Let's hurry before more undead appear!

Now swing harder!

choice.text: I knew we should have waited for General Daisuke.

Still, what I wouldn't give for General Daisuke and his troops to hurry the hell up...
Ha! Will the Shira Tancho do, Satoshi?
Hachimaru --?!
Not just me, Fumio! I've brough some friends, too...
You managed to gather so many of the Old Guard--?! But how?
Do you think Shou and I have been twiddling our thumbs at the Imperial shrine all this time, Satoshi? No, we've been rounding up the rest of our clan!
The experience was... interesting, to say the least.
Atsushi, Itsuke... whoa, it's a regular Shira Tancho reunion!
Hee Hee! I knew you guys wouldn't let us down!
Let's see how tough these monsters really are!
We need more men. There's just too many for us to fight through alone.
Ha! We've come too far to call it quits now, friend.

But how did you know where to find us?
Ah, it's an interesting story.
After Shou and I gathered up as many of the Old Guard as we could, we all traveled back to the Imperial shrine to await word from you or Hiroshi.
Days passed by and we heard nothing, but then a very odd young lady claiming to be of the Kagehito ninja clan appeared outside the shrine saying she needed our help.
Shou, what was her name again?
Her name was Chikako, Hachimaru-sensei.
Yes, that's it -- Chikako! Very peculiar young lady.
Anyway, She seemed convinced you were all destined to meet your end if we didn't do something, so we decided to travel to the Cha Tonbo territory as fast as we could.
We used one of her clan's ninja trails to get here. Very impressive. It saved us days of travel time.
Whoa... that Chikako, she sure had her wits about her.
Yes, and it is fortunate for us that she did.
With your new friends to aid us, I think we have the strength to break through this ambush.
I think so, yes. We Shira Tancho are experts at fighting our way out of tight situations.
Ha! Yeah, and we've been in more than a few.
So, are we ready?
We're ready. Let's go deliver some long overdue justice to that bastard Takamori.

dialogue.text: Well, well... so here you guys are, right on time. It’s just like Takamori-dono predicted.
You village roughnecks didn’t honestly think you could outwit the greatest strategic mind in the Empire, did you? He had your little maneuver pegged right from the start.
Magoichi --!
GRRR...! Let me at him, Satoshi! I'm gonna make him pay for what he did to Mitsuo!
Man, you guys still smarting over that friend of yours? Sheesh! Just get over it already...
Why you little --
Say, there's more of you this time. Are all these Old Guard too?
We are, and I hear you took the life of one of our friends.
Heh! I'll admit it wasn't my best work, but it was my first Shira Tancho kill.
I'll be much better at it this time.
Tell us where Takamori has gone to, Magoichi.
Takamori-dono's got an appointment with destiny, pal. By the time I finish with you, the Murasaki Tsuki will have an army larger than every clan combined.
And it's all thanks to Shira Tancho and the Cha Tonbo, not to mention a little help from our new best friends, the Silent Song.
But don't worry about those guys, though. They're expendable.
Takamori-dono will deal with them after the ceremony's finished.
No more words, Magoichi. It's time to fight!
So it looks like this is the end of the road for you guys. Too bad...
I mean, you'll never get to see what my lord has planned for this country. Those undead you fought to get here, they're just the start!
Now that we have the key to open the ruins to the north, we'll take the magic inside Masahiro's body and make a thousand times this number.
Takamori-dono has already said I could keep you guys as practice dummies. The Shira Tancho, my own private sparring partners!
I hope you guys fight better dead than you do alive!

step.title: Catch up to the Murasaki Tsuki Army

dialogue.text: That's for Mitsuo...
Huh! Not quite, but it'll do for now.
Let's find Takamori.
What comes next won't be easy, youngsters. Everything we've faced so far... it has been a prelude.
The real test of your courage begins now!
If we stand together, we'll win.
We fight as a team, we win as a team... if we must, we'll die as a team.
Our swords, pledged to our lord; our lives, spent in his cause. The White Crane commands, and we, the vanguard, obey
The Shira Tancho Oath of Fealty, spoken by every new member of the vanguard.
Satoshi, I'm surprised you remember it.
What can I say? I haven't drank in a while.
Ha! Then you should stay off the wine more often!
Hee hee! Yeah, you almost sound like Shinmen, you know that?
I never thought I'd consider that a compliment, Fumio.
Heh! But I like it!

choice.text: I'll aid the Shira Tancho and honor my sensei!
The Shira Tancho mean nothing to me.

dialogue.text: I may not be a Shira Tancho, but I'll do my best to end Takamori's plan. It's what my sensei would have done in my place
Heh! You might not be one of us, but you're certainly our friend.
Satoshi's right. Without your bravery, we wouldn't have gotten this far
Yeah, the Shira Tancho owe you big time for this!
Thank you, all of you. I'm honored.
My friends, I think it's time we left this place.
Takamori's army went north, and we need to catch up with him.
But are we ready to face Takamori? The battle with be long and difficult, and we may not be able to turn back once we enter the shrine. We should make sure we are properly prepared.
Indeed. If there's anything outstanding that needs to be set right, now's the time to do it!
Heh! We can discuss my fee later!
I'm not a Shira Tancho, and I can't begin to understand what you're all talking about.
Can we beat him? I mean, are we strong enough to beat Takamori?
Come back! It's this way!
Come back! It's this way!

step.title: Catch up to the Murasaki Tsuki Army
Catch up to the Murasaki Tsuki Army

dialogue.text: So this is it... the final battle.
We've walked a long road to get here, but the hardest mile remains ahead of us.
Huh! Bring it on, I say. I'm ready for it!
Yes, justice for our lord can wait no longer.
Aye to that.
Well, we have one last chance to turn back and resupply. Otherwise, I say we finish this.
Drats! The corridor is blocked -- with more undead!
Step aside, Kojuro-sama. Shou and I will handle this
My sword is ready, sensei.
Good. Now let's deal with these monsters!
Sensei -- look! The undead are rising again!
Sigh! Then we'll need to knock them back down, won't we?
Shou, you and I will stay here with some of the Old Guard, and we'll and hold these demons off.
The rest of you will need to go on without us.
We can't risk being separated in here, Hachimaru. We need to stick together!
Shou and I will be fine, have no fear of that.
Trust in your companions' abilities, youngster. They won't let us down.
Fine. Hachimaru, I'll see you later.
Ancestors watch over you, Hachimaru.
Yeah, we'll see you top-side later on.
Once this is over and Takamori's beaten, we'll find an inn and celebrate.
The first round's on me!
Ha! That's all the reason we need to stay to alive, Satoshi.
Now, Shou, are you ready?
Yes, Sensei. I am ready.
Then let's go get them!
And we need to get moving too!
Good luck and stay safe. We'll meet you later.
Wow! The ruins open into a cave!
Say, isn't that another one of those Kanji statues?

intro.text: Rumble.

dialogue.text: What the heck was that?!
Felt like an earthquake.
No, that was no earthquake, Satoshi.
Curses! Takamori must have started the ceremony!
Then we don't have much time left...
Yes, we need to hurry and find him!
Man, more undead. Lots of 'em, too.
Takamori must be hiding behind that door! we'll need to fight through them!
We know the routine, Kojuro-sama. Leave them to us!
These guys just don't know when to quit!
You knock 'em down, they stand right back up again!
Ha! Well, what do you expect? They're already dead!
They're even stronger than they were before.
That'll be Takamori's doing. Until we find him and stop the ceremony, these monsters won't be beaten!

choice.text: There are too many of them!

dialogue.text: Then we need to push on. We can't afford to stop now.

intro.label: label1

dialogue.text: Fumio, Yuudai... I think it's about time we showed these rotting bags of pus-filled flesh just what the Shira Tancho are all about.
Huh! Damn right!
The three of us will them off up here with the rest of the Old Guard.
Friend, you and Kojuro go stop Takamori!
No way in hell am I abandoning you guys. If we die, we die together!

intro.label: label2

dialogue.text: Who said anything about dying? We're the Shira Tancho Old Guard! Too tough to quit, too dumb to die -- that's us!
Now get going -- and don’t worry about us! We'll meet you outside for the victory celebration!
I'll hold you to that, Satoshi!
Ready, guys?
You bet!
Let them come!
Hmm, my last drop of sake...
I didn't want to do this, but... Oh, to hell with it.

intro.text: Glug, glug, glug...

dialogue.text: Hic! For the Shira Tancho!
Kojuro-san, let's get moving!
Right behind you, youngster.
Look after yourselves, you three. If any of you die, you'll have me to answer to.
We can't hold them all of any defeat Takamori at the same time -- there's just too many of them
Your continued defiance is an affront to my master, ronin. I shall end your life now.

choice.text: I'll try to make her understand.

dialogue.text: What your master plans to do is plain insanity, Amaya-sama. He is playing with forces he doesn't understand!
You're an honorable samurai, surely you can see that!
And an honorable samurai serves her lord till the end
Lord Takamori has spent every waking hour planning for this day, and no force on earth can prevent the Murasaki Tsuki from achieving victory now!
I will teach you the price for disrespecting my lord!
Then you've made your choice. Your loyalty to your lord is admirable, even if you are deluded.
I am General Amaya, the she-wolf of the Murasaki Tsuki!
Victory to my lord Takamori -- and death to his enemies!
Then you'll die a fool's death like the rest of your clan!
You'll get no mercy from me, Amaya. I'm here to put an end to the Murasaki Tsuki.
Mercy? My Lord was right when he said the Shira Tancho and their allies fail to understand their place in the world.
But I will teach you your place, ronin.
This way, quick!
Drats! The ceremony is almost finished!
Ah, the wandering hero is here...
Your arrival is fortuitious, ronin. You will be the first to watch the climax of a drama five years in the making.

choice.text: The Murasaki Tsuki have been defeated!

dialogue.text: What sort of ruler allies with demons and black magic users?
The pragmatic kind, ronin. The kind who sees behind the blinding veil of personal vanity and self-defeating pride.
Masahiro taught the people to fear the power of the spirit world, but spirit magic is simply another tool to be exploited.
After all, would you cast aside a sword because it cut too deeply, an arrow because it flew too straight? No, you would use them, just as I intend to use the spirits of Yomi.
A sword wielded virtuously has the capacity to make as well as to break. The spirits of Yomi -- mindless, directionless and ultimately powerless unless properly compelled -- are really no different.
You damned crazy lunatic! You don't have the first idea of what you're dealing with!
The spirits you place in the bodies of men are pure evil -- they exist to consume life, not defend it!
Your shortsighted counsel is not wanted, old man. I'm not so easily cowed by petty myths and half-rememebered fables as that fool Masahiro was.
Your army has been routed and your generals slain, Takamori. Whatever you're hoping to achieve here, it won't change the fact that your clan is defeated.
The world is being remade, ronin; the old order is being torn down, stripped away. Such dramatic change necessitates great sacrifice.
Besides, my army's defeat is but a minor setback. Two thousand warriors lost here in this campaign? There are one hundred times that number awaiting my command to march...
once they rise from their graves...
I can't let you complete the ceremony, Takamori. I swore an oath that I'd stop you, and that's what I'm going to do.
Hm. I admire you, ronin. Your determination is the stuff of legend.
Alas, valor alone never won a war, and valor alone never held the shogunate.
Once I have defeated you and completed the ceremony to remove the Void Key, I shall forge an army large enough to crush all who oppose me.

Every life lost in this futile clan war will add yet another recruit into my legion's ranks. Aka Ryu, Aoi Hoiru, Midori Ken, Ki Sensu... all who fall shall join my army as I enact my plan to unite this land under one banner.
Truly, you're beyond redemption, Gojo Takamori!
Ha! Ha! Ha! It is I who shall decide who is fit for redemption and who is not, old man.
Now... let us end this.
A... a most impressive display of swordsmanship. You are every inch the warrior I suspected.
You've got him on the back foot, youngster! Now's the time to finish him off!
Finish me off? Ha! Ha! Ha!
Can you not see? The ceremony is all but complete! Oiwa, show them the error of their wa --

intro.text: Shik!

dialogue.text: Ugh --!
W-what --?!
Your arrogance is most unbecoming, my lord Takamori.
O... Oiwa... but you promised --
I promised that the Shira Tancho would fall and the dead would rise, and so it has happened.
B-but... you said... you said the Void Key would grant me the power to take the shogunate...
And that it still shall, my Lord. Your corpse will look splendid leading the Silent Song's new army!
You... you traitorous devil!
Hmm, indeed. But truly, is there any other kind?
Ugh...
So you planned to betray Takamori all along...
Hahaha! No, I simply allowed him to believe we were allies.
The Murasaki Tsuki were convenient foils for the Silent Song; They allowed us to achieve our aims free of outside interference, just as you allowed this old man to reach me unhindered.
Isn't that right, Kojuro-sama?
Eh --?! You vile she-serpent! I'll thank you to not use my name unbidden!
My, my... you haven't changed at all. So crochety!
Heh! And nor have you, Oiwa. Tell me, how many innocent lives has it taken to maintain your beauty?
Ha! Not all of us are blessed with your stubborn longevity, Kojuro-sama. You Kanji do not die easily!

intro.label: label1

choice.text: Kojuro is one of the Kanji?!
What is she planning to do now?

dialogue.text: Kojuro, you're one of the Kanji clan–?!
Heh! Ex-Kanji, youngster. I used to be one but it's a long story for another time. Besides, You don't get to my age without collecting a few secrets.
Oh! So you didn't even share your identity with your new friends? Shame on you for being so secretive, Kojuro-sama...
Bah! That's rich, coming from a serpent-tongued corpse fondler like you!
Tut! Sticks and stones, Kojuro-sama. But I'll allow you your moment of defiance.
It will certainly be your last.
So you allied with the Murasaki Tsuki for... what?
For the Void Key, what else?
Oh, Takamori believed the key would bring him infinite power -- but the truth is quite different.
The Void Key holds no power to command the undead; only we, the Silent Song possess such knowledge.
But it was by the power of this miserable Kanji relic that Masahiro struck down lord Hideaki Jodai, and its destruction must be assured before he rises again.
What --?! But there's no way that monster can return!
Ha ha ha! You underestimate Hideaki-sensei, Kojuro-sama. My lord's spirit lives on at the threshold of Yomi.
Yes, he has conquered the barrier of death, proven the purity of his spirit. And now, all he waits for is an opportunity to return to us and recommence the Great Work.
Killing Masahiro would not be enough to ensure the Tenet of the Void's destruction. The magic of the tenet would remain for others to use against us.
But by claiming it for ourselves, no force under heaven will be able to stop our master's revenge!
I've heard enough! Step away from the shogun's corpse, you devil!
Mwahahahaha!
Let'sss sssee what lord Takamori hasss to sssay about that!
What the --?!
GWAARGH!
Aboshi, Takamori... ssslay them!
You work your magic and I'll work mine, youngster! Keep them distracted while I perform the Sealing Ritual!
Heh! We did it, youngster! We've sealed the Void Key!
You're beaten, Oiwa, you black-hearted monster!
You foolish old man! Do you honestly believe you've won?

intro.text: Rumble.

dialogue.text: Whether the Void Key is in my hands or not, Hideaki-sensei's return cannot be prevented!
All you have accomplished is a postponement of the agony which awaits you.
I shall see you again, Kojuro-sama. Be certain of that!
And you, ronin, I will be sure to keep an eye on you in the future!
Blast it all! Quickly, we've got to get out of here -- the temple's collapsing!

intro.text: Rumble.

dialogue.text: What about that monster? We can't let her get away!
Let the serpent slither off into the darkness. We'll find her some other time!

intro.label: label1

dialogue.text: Now let's hurry and escape, youngster! You don't get to my age by standing about while a ceiling's falling down around your ears!
What --?! You'll do no such thing! My legs are perfectly capable of carrying me wherever I want to go!
Don't you worry about me, youngster. I'm pretty nimble when my life depends on it!

intro.text: Rumble.

dialogue.text: Guys , look! It's --
Well I'll be damned... you made it!
Man, we thought you'd bought it when the shrine started to collapse!
Yes, we only just made it out in time ourselves. It was a close call.
General Daisuke and his soldiers arrived in the nick of time and helped clear out an escape route for us. Many thanks to the Cha Tonbo.
The Cha Tonbo played only a small part in this victory today. The real credit goes to you warriors of the Shira Tancho.
Not entirely to us, Daisuke-sama. If not for our friend and Kojuro here, no doubt the Murasaki Tsuki would be celebrating a dark victory this day.
Speaking which, where did that old rooster get to anyway? I didn't see him leave the shrine with you...
Did he... did he make out?

choice.text: I thought he was behind me.
He must have been trapped in the shrine.

dialogue.text: He was right behind me. We must have become seperated during the escape...

intro.label: label1

dialogue.text: Poor old guy...
I'd never admit it to his face, but I actually quite liked him.
Sure he smelled like wet cabbage and mumbled a lot, and the way he said "Heh!" all the time really got on my nerves.
But Kojuro-san helped us out more times than I can count, and I don't think we would have gotten this far without him.
His sacrifice will be remembered along with Mitsuo and everyone else who died to earn us this victory.
I guess that means the Void Key is lost, too.
Probably, but if you ask me, that's for the best. Ancient magic... mystic artifacts... some things are too dangerous to risk messing with.
Indeed. The Void Key should remain buried, safe and out of the hands of those who would seek to use it for personal gain.
So what happened to Gojo Takamori? Please tell me you stopped that monster once and for all.

choice.text: What the hell, I'll take the glory!

dialogue.text: Gojo Takamori is dead, but I didn't slay him. He was betrayed by Oiwa.

intro.label: label2

dialogue.text: So the traitor got a taste of his own medicine, eh? Poetic.
But the Silent Song have not been defeated. This victory today, though important, was only a setback.
It took the strength of every clan united to defeat them before.
But now that the clans are at each other's throats...
The land will be easy pickings!
Bah, let's worry about the future later. After all, we did just save the Empire!
You're right, Hachimaru. I suppose we've earned ourselves a rest.
Exactly. So, what do you fellows intend to do now?
I made a promise to Mitsuo that I'd deliver his bow to his family, and that's not a promise I intend to break.
I'll hit the road as soon as possible, and travel to Haruka's farm.
Say, you mind if I tag along with you, Satoshi? I mean, we Shira Tancho ought to stick together.
Sure thing, Fumio. Yuudai, what about you?
It will be winter soon, and the persimmons should be almost ripe. I dread to think how fat the sparrows have grown off my vegetable patch.
Hey, Yuudai, don't say that! It'll be a shame to say goodbye again!
Hmm... you're right, I suppose it would. Traveling the open road might be better for now, at least until planting season. Besides, what hope have I for a peaceful future if the land remains at war?
That's the spirit, you old basket head! Let's go out there and make a difference!

I think Shou and I will follow you too, at least for a short while. There's a lot the boy still needs to learn, and I have a feeling his ramen bowl of a brain stopped taking in my words a long time ago.
I would be honored to travel with you all.
Ha! Oh, stop being so bloody stuffy all the time, Shou. Lighten up!
So that just leaves you, my friend. What will you do now?

choice.text: There's still a war to fight.

dialogue.text: Gojo Takamori is defeated, but that doesn't mean the Great Clans are suddenly going to put aside their differences and live in peace. There's a war to fight, and I intend to be a part of it.

intro.label: label3

dialogue.text: Well, whatever road you end up taking, always remember you're a friend of the Shira Tancho.
Hee hee! Yeah, whether you want us or not!
Fate willing, our paths will cross again, friend. Our clan are in your debt, and we always honor our debts.
Honor our debts, yes... And while we're on that subject, didn't Satoshi say he'd buy us all a drink?
What--?! Hey! I never said anything of the sort!
Hee hee! You did, Satoshi. We heard you!
And we'd never lie about something as important as that.
Shou, did you hear Satoshi say he'd buy us all a drink?
As a matter of fact I do, Sensei. I distinctly remember the words "drink" and "on me" being spoken by Satoshi-sama.
Ha! Ha! I take back everything I said about you, Shou. You're a most attentive student!
Sigh! All right, all right... the first round's on me.
Hee Hee! A toast to our victory!
A samurai's training is never complete. I'll continue my travels, honing my skills until I achieve perfection.
I'm not sure... I suppose I'll let fate decide.
I did... Well, sort of. Oiwa got to him first, but he needed to be ran through a couple more times before the message sunk in.
I don't think he did it...
The Shira Tancho must not pass!
Heh! We'll see about that!
Lead the way, Satoshi!
Warriors of the White Crane, let's get them!
Stop the Shira Tancho!
Grr...! Not today, pal!
I've had about as much as I can take from you Murasaki Tsuki!
Prepare to be stomped flat!
We're with you, Fumio!
These guys don't stand a chance!
The Shira Tancho must not open the gate!
Like seeds upon stoney ground, your efforts will come to naught, warrior!
We'll fight alongside you, Yuudai!
Then follow me, brothers!

intro.text: Meanwhile in a hidden cave...

dialogue.text: The five of us are assembled in accordance with you request, brother. I must confess, the urgency of you summons has me intrigued.
And I, too. It isn't often we are ordered to gather at such short notice.
I take it this meeting is connected in some way to the death of the shogun?
Heh!
The death of the shogun, yes, but also the rebirth of another, much more powerful foe...
Hideaki Jodai, the so-called Koe No Jigoku, is preparing to threaten this land once again.
You mean the Silent Song, brother, surely? Hideaki Jodai was defeated five years ago.
Defeated, yes. But slain once and for all? I'm not too sure...
Nothing must stand between us and ultimate victory, not even the so-called Voice of Hell himself.
Indeed, and this is why I bring you... this!
That is... that is the Void key! But how did you manage to retrieve it?
It's a long story, and I'm too tired to explain it all right now. My recent foray into the world has left me a little... drained.
Suffice to say, I was forced to recruit a few accomplices to aid me.
These accomplices... Are they aware of our plans?
No, I think I fooled them.
Good. Then the time for action has finally arrived. has arrived.
Indeed, but tread lightly, my brothers and sisters. The journey of a thousand miles commences with a single step, and this is just the beginning of our quest.
Only through caution and planning will we...
The Kakuremichi
… bring about the great change that we seek!
